content.text: In regions where conventional payment platforms like Stripe fail, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-first-principles|Digital Product]] creators face significant barriers to building a viable online store. With COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can establish a robust [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-what-actually-how-3|crypto]] store on Cloudflare Pages. This guide walks you through the streamlined process of configuring your online store that operates independently from restrictive platforms, enabling you to harness the full power of digital commerce.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH infrastructure stands out because it eliminates dependency on traditional payment systems that often restrict access in various countries. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you gain a system designed to operate without the limitations imposed by centralized platforms. This means [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment|COREMERCH guide to complete]] ownership and control over your store, ensuring you can process payments seamlessly and deliver products directly to your customers.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, gather essential tools: a Cloudflare account for hosting, a Google account for Apps Script, and a NOWPayments account for handling cryptocurrency payments. Additionally, prepare your digital products, which can include eBooks, courses, or any downloadable content. Having your branding elements, such as logos and product descriptions, ready will expedite the process. Also, ensure you have a clear understanding of your target audience to tailor your offerings effectively.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your Cloudflare Pages to host your store's frontend. Use Google Apps Script to manage the backend logic, including order processing and product delivery. Integrate NOWPayments to facilitate on-chain crypto payments, supporting over 300 cryptocurrencies. This setup allows for instant processing and automated order confirmations. Testing your pipeline is critical—ensure that transactions are smooth and product delivery occurs as expected, laying a solid foundation for your store’s operations.
Achieve total ownership of your store—no platforms, no subscriptions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your setup is complete, it’s time to go live. Promote your store through social media and other channels to attract your first customers. Monitor your transaction processes closely during this initial phase. With NOWPayments’ auto-confirmation feature, you’ll receive notifications as soon as payments are processed. This immediate feedback loop allows you to address any potential issues rapidly, ensuring customer satisfaction and trust in your new crypto store.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After establishing your store and processing initial transactions, consider how to scale operations. Use insights from customer interactions and sales data to refine your product offerings. Expand your marketing efforts and explore additional sales channels. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides resources to further enhance your setup, including blueprints and templates to streamline future growth. Embrace continuous improvement to maintain an edge in the evolving digital commerce landscape.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize Cloudflare Pages for hosting, integrate NOWPayments for transaction processing, and leverage Google Apps Script for backend logic. This infrastructure allows you to own your store completely without reliance on traditional payment systems, making it ideal for regions where such platforms are unavailable.
Launch your crypto store and start generating revenue in under 48 hours.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in expanding your capabilities, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It contains all six blueprints and seven templates necessary for building and scaling a sovereign digital commerce stack. Explore related topics like GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages for hosting your crypto payment solutions at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages?

Start by creating a Cloudflare account for hosting. Use NOWPayments for crypto transactions and Google Apps Script for backend processing. Deploy your infrastructure, test thoroughly, and then promote your store to start selling.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script for a quicker deployment, taking 4-6 hours. Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages and Workers, offering a more robust setup deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, fully tested before handoff.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both platforms are suitable for hosting digital product stores. GitHub Pages is ideal for simpler setups, while Cloudflare Pages provides enhanced performance and scalability, especially when combined with additional tools like NOWPayments.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept through NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, enabling you to accept a diverse range of payments. This flexibility is crucial for reaching a broader audience and catering to varying customer preferences.
How quickly can I start accepting payments?

With Stack 02, you can be fully operational in 48 hours. Your payment processing will be automated through NOWPayments, allowing you to start accepting crypto payments almost immediately after deployment.
